historical_record.description: Daly City opened a temporary parking lot for BART commuters on the triangular site, about 82,550 square feet of which 23,750 lie in San Francisco, on 1 January 1976, under a one-year authorisation the City Planning Commission granted on 29 May 1975.
The City Planning Commission voted 5-1 to let Daly City's 250-space BART parking lot on the site continue for one more year (Resolution 7616).
